# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
project/
├── Dockerfile
├── .dockerignore
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── src/
    └── index.ts
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# ============================================================
# Stage 1: Dependencies
# Install ALL dependencies (including devDependencies)
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS dependencies

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy package files first to leverage Docker layer caching
# This layer only rebuilds when package files change
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install all dependencies including devDependencies
# --frozen-lockfile ensures reproducible installs
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# ============================================================
# Stage 2: Builder
# Compile TypeScript to JavaScript
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

# Copy installed dependencies from previous stage
COPY --from=dependencies /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy TypeScript configuration and source files
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/

# Copy package.json (needed for npm scripts)
COPY package.json ./

# Compile TypeScript → JavaScript
# Output goes to /app/dist (as configured in tsconfig.json)
RUN npm run build

# ============================================================
# Stage 3: Production Dependencies
# Install ONLY production dependencies (no devDependencies)
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS prod-dependencies

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install only production dependencies
# This significantly reduces node_modules size
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev

# ============================================================
# Stage 4: Runner (Final Image)
# Minimal image with only what's needed to run the app
# ============================================================
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner

# Install dumb-init for proper signal handling and PID 1 management
# This ensures graceful shutdowns work correctly
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init

# Create a non-root user for security
# Running as root in containers is a security risk
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && \
    adduser --system --uid 1001 --ingroup nodejs appuser

WORKDIR /app

# Copy only production node_modules from prod-dependencies stage
COPY --from=prod-dependencies --chown=appuser:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy compiled JavaScript from builder stage
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:nodejs /app/dist ./dist

# Copy package.json (needed for runtime metadata)
COPY --chown=appuser:nodejs package.json ./

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Expose application port
EXPOSE 3000

# Set NODE_ENV to production
ENV NODE_ENV=production

# Use dumb-init as entrypoint to handle signals properly
# Then run the compiled application
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init", "--"]
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## Supporting Files

### .dockerignore
```dockerignore
# Dependencies (will be installed fresh in Docker)
node_modules/

# TypeScript source (only compiled output is needed in final image)
# Note: src/ IS needed in builder stage, so we can't ignore it globally
# Instead, we use selective COPY commands in the Dockerfile

# Build output (will be generated fresh)
dist/

# Development and config files
.git/
.gitignore
.env
.env.*
*.env

# Logs
logs/
*.log
npm-debug.log*

# Test files
**/*.test.ts
**/*.spec.ts
**/__tests__/
coverage/

# IDE files
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp
*.swo

# OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# CI/CD
.github/
.gitlab-ci.yml

# Documentation
README.md
docs/

# Docker files themselves
Dockerfile*
docker-compose*
```

### tsconfig.json
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": false,
    "sourceMap": false,
    "removeComments": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noImplicitReturns": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.spec.ts"]
}
```

### package.json
```json
{
  "name": "my-typescript-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Node.js TypeScript application",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node src/index.ts",
    "lint": "eslint src/**/*.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  }
}
```

### src/index.ts (Example Application)
```typescript
import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

app.use(express.json());

app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({
    status: 'healthy',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV,
  });
});

app.get('/', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Hello from TypeScript!' });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Server running on port ${PORT}`);
});

export default app;
```

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-ts-app:latest .

# Build with specific target stage (useful for debugging)
docker build --target builder -t my-ts-app:debug .

# Run the container
docker run -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env my-ts-app:latest

# Run with environment variables
docker run -p 3000:3000 \
  -e NODE_ENV=production \
  -e PORT=3000 \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Check image size
docker images my-ts-app

# Inspect image layers
docker history my-ts-app:latest

# Run with docker-compose
docker-compose up --build
```

## Docker Compose (Optional)

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.9'

services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runner          # Build only up to the runner stage
    image: my-ts-app:latest
    container_name: ts-app
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - PORT=3000
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--no-verbose", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '0.5'
```

## Size Comparison

```
Stage               Base Image        Approximate Size
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node:20             Full Debian       ~1.1 GB
node:20-slim        Slim Debian       ~240 MB
node:20-alpine      Alpine Linux      ~180 MB
Final image         node:20-alpine    ~120 MB  ✓
```

## Key Optimizations Explained

| Technique | Benefit |
|-----------|---------|
| **Multi-stage builds** | Excludes build tools, TypeScript compiler, and devDependencies from final image |
| **Alpine base image** | ~75% smaller than full Debian node image |
| **`npm ci` instead of `npm install`** | Faster, reproducible, uses lockfile exactly |
| **`--omit=dev` flag** | Excludes devDependencies from production image |
| **Layer caching** | `package.json` copied before source code; dependencies only reinstall when packages change |
| **`dumb-init`** | Proper PID 1 signal handling for graceful shutdowns |
| **Non-root user** | Security best practice; limits blast radius of vulnerabilities |
| **`--chown` in COPY** | Sets file ownership in a single layer instead of a separate `RUN chown` command |
| **`.dockerignore`** | Prevents unnecessary files from entering build context |
| **`sourceMap: false`** | Excludes source maps from compiled output |
| **`removeComments: true`** | Slightly reduces compiled file sizes |
